-- Names come from untrusted requests. A name counts only if it is
-- a single plain file name with no path separators or dot-dot parts.
is_plain_name(name: str) -> bool =
  ex is_plain_name("a.txt") == True
  ex is_plain_name("../x") == False
  if name == "" or name == "." or name == ".."
    return False
  if name.split("/").len() > 1
    return False
  True

-- Reads notes/<name>. The body narrows fs to "notes" with
-- `with fs = fs.sub("notes")`, so nothing outside that directory is reachable.
-- A missing, unreadable, or non-plain name gives "".
read_note(name: str) -> str uses fs =
  post out == "" or is_plain_name(name)
  ex read_note("missing.txt") == ""
  ex read_note("../x") == ""
  if is_plain_name(name) == False
    return ""
  with fs = fs.sub("notes")
    fs.read(name) else err -> ""

-- Counts names whose note can be read. A file that is read but is
-- empty is not distinguishable from a failed read here, so this
-- counts names with a non-empty note.
count_readable(names: List[str]) -> int uses fs =
  post out >= 0
  post out <= names.len()
  ex count_readable([]) == 0
  ex count_readable(["../x"]) == 0
  var n = 0
  for name in names
    if read_note(name) != ""
      n += 1
  n
